projects.title: 840 Apartments Foundation Project
projects.shortDesc: Foundation construction for 27 residential buildings providing housing for 840 families.
projects.fullDesc: Comprehensive foundation construction project for 27 residential buildings at PK-13. Each building encompasses 200 square meters of foundation work, totaling 5,400 m² of high-precision structural foundation. The project was commissioned by the Ministry of Planning and Development and successfully implemented by BINAYA-IMMO GROUP in collaboration with GACEC. This large-scale housing initiative demonstrates our expertise in managing multi-building residential developments with stringent quality and timeline requirements.
tasks: Site preparation and excavation for 27 building foundations
Structural foundation engineering and reinforcement
Concrete pouring and curing for 5,400 m² of foundations
Quality control and structural integrity testing
Coordination with Ministry of Planning and Development
requirements: Compliance with national building codes and standards
High-strength concrete specifications for residential buildings
Safety protocols for large-scale construction site

projects.title: Al Rayyan Cafeteria & Mosque Complex
projects.client: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs
projects.donor: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs
projects.shortDesc: Iron ceiling installation for integrated cafeteria, mosque, and administrative complex.
projects.fullDesc: Sophisticated iron ceiling construction project for the Al Rayyan multi-purpose complex, encompassing a cafeteria, mosque, and administrative offices spanning 1,050 square meters. This project showcases our expertise in specialized metalwork and structural engineering for religious and public facilities. The iron ceiling system was designed to meet both functional requirements and aesthetic considerations, providing durable, elegant coverage for this important community space. Implemented by GACEC with precision craftsmanship and adherence to Islamic architectural principles.
tasks: Structural assessment and design for iron ceiling system
Custom fabrication of iron ceiling components
Installation of 1,050 m² iron ceiling structure
Integration with mosque architectural requirements
Coordination with Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs
requirements: Acoustic considerations for mosque prayer areas
Fire safety and building code compliance

projects.title: Hamoudi Commercial Center
projects.client: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs
projects.donor: Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs
projects.shortDesc: Comprehensive concrete and iron ceiling works for commercial development.
projects.fullDesc: Multi-phase commercial construction project at Plus Rambo, featuring first-floor concrete structural works integrated with specialized iron ceiling installation and comprehensive architectural design services. First-floor concrete foundation and structural works
Iron ceiling fabrication and installation
Integration of commercial building systems
Project management and quality assurance

projects.title: CNSS Hangar Facility
projects.shortDesc: Large-scale 3,000 m² industrial hangar construction for CNSS operations.
projects.fullDesc: Comprehensive construction of a 3,000 square meter industrial hangar facility in Arta Governorate for the Ministry of Labor's CNSS (National Social Security Fund). This large-scale infrastructure project required specialized expertise in industrial construction, including extensive structural steelwork, roofing systems, and foundation engineering suitable for heavy industrial use. The hangar provides critical operational space for CNSS activities and demonstrates our capability to deliver major infrastructure projects on time and within specification. Executed under private contract with full project management by GACEC.
tasks: Site preparation and foundation engineering for 3,000 m²
Structural steel framework design and erection
Industrial roofing system installation
Concrete floor and drainage systems
Quality control and safety management

projects.title: Dikhil Central Mosque Complex
projects.shortDesc: Complete mosque complex with separate facilities for men and women, annexes, and imam's residence.
projects.fullDesc: Comprehensive religious facility construction in Dikhil's Mashah district, featuring a complete mosque complex with separate prayer areas for men and women, auxiliary annexes, and a dedicated imam's residence. This 750 square meter project showcases GACEC's expertise in religious architecture and our commitment to serving communities across Djibouti. The design incorporates traditional Islamic architectural elements while meeting modern building standards and accessibility requirements. Funded by philanthropist Al-haji Elmi Guesod, this mosque serves as a spiritual and community center for the Dikhil region.
tasks: Architectural design incorporating Islamic principles
Separate prayer hall construction for men and women
Annexe facilities for ablution and community use
Imam's residence construction and finishing
Landscaping and exterior finishing
requirements: Qibla orientation precision for prayer direction
Acoustic design for call to prayer
Accessibility for worshippers of all ages

projects.title: Mosquée Nashroudiin
projects.shortDesc: Larger mosque complex with comprehensive facilities spanning 1,150 m².
projects.fullDesc: Major religious construction project at Plateau de Serpent in Djibouti, encompassing 1,150 square meters of sophisticated Islamic architecture. This expansive mosque complex includes separate prayer facilities for men and women, comprehensive auxiliary spaces, and a complete imam's residence in the Mashah architectural style. The project demonstrates our expertise in large-scale religious construction and our ability to create spiritually meaningful spaces that serve growing communities. Commissioned by Al-haji Osman Okieh, this mosque stands as a testament to community philanthropy and GACEC's construction excellence.
tasks: Large-scale mosque construction with 1,150 m² footprint
Dual prayer hall design and construction
Comprehensive annexe and support facilities
Integrated imam's residence
Site development and infrastructure
requirements: Superior acoustic engineering for large prayer spaces

projects.title: Haramous Luxury Villa Complex
projects.shortDesc: Four premium duplex villas with terraces totaling 1,600 m².
projects.fullDesc: Sophisticated residential development in the Haramous district featuring four luxury duplex villas with expansive terraces, totaling 1,600 square meters of premium living space. This project showcases GACEC's expertise in high-end residential construction, combining modern architectural design with quality craftsmanship. Each villa features duplex configuration with rooftop terraces, providing residents with exceptional living spaces and outdoor amenities. The development was commissioned by Zahra Ibrahim Direh and represents our commitment to delivering premium residential solutions that meet the highest standards of quality and design.
tasks: Architectural design for four duplex villas
Foundation and structural construction for 1,600 m²
Terrace and rooftop development
Interior finishing and premium materials installation
Landscaping and site development
